Inspect the complete supplied artifacts and bind findings to their provenance.

No task_card_check, model_config_check, or sacg_static_check result is supplied; their status is not_run.
The accelerator boundary remains Transformer blocks only. Embedding/tokenization, final model norm, LM head/logits, sampling, and other model-tail work are outside the DUT scope.
proposed_actions: Inspect the complete task_card, model_config, and relevant case_adapter facts with provenance, then record each audited field as explicitly supplied, ambiguous, contradictory, or not visible in the complete source.
Run the registered task-card, model-config, and SACG static checks and use their results to populate the model intake audit and assumptions/gaps handoff.
Keep unresolved fields explicit and block semantic SACG extraction from relying on guessed defaults; do not change model semantics or accelerator architecture.
risks: SACG extraction could encode invented or unsupported model semantics if hidden dimensions, attention/head mapping, sequence behavior, or operator order are inferred instead of cited to source artifacts.

Cross-artifact contradictions involving task intent, decoder configuration, tensor shapes, attention mapping, sequence settings, or residual/operator ordering cannot be assessed until detailed artifact contents and provenance are available.
Do not interpret this limited prompt view as proof that required fields are absent; request and inspect the complete artifact contents before recording field-level gaps.
